general_rule: Apply exactly one synthetic shift family at a time to the original 224x224 grayscale image before three-channel replication and ImageNet normalization.

brightness.operation: multiply grayscale intensity by fixed factor, then clip to [0,255]

contrast.operation: adjust contrast around image mean: (pixel-mean)*factor + mean, then clip

gaussian_noise.operation: add zero-mean Gaussian noise in 8-bit intensity space and clip to [0,255]
gaussian_noise.seed_policy: deterministic per-image seed derived from global seed + image identifier + severity

gaussian_blur.operation: Gaussian blur applied to grayscale image

resolution_degradation.operation: downsample original 224x224 image using bilinear interpolation and resize back to 224x224 using bilinear interpolation

evaluation_rules.probability_calibration: Use the temperature learned on clean validation data. Do not refit temperature separately for each shifted condition.

validation_policy: Development analysis may be performed on the frozen validation cohort under these predefined shifts.
test_policy: Test data remains untouched until methodology, shift protocol, uncertainty measures, and analysis pipeline are frozen.
